description: Create a blank draft form in the authenticated organization. Requires an org API key or OAuth sign-in with the forms:write scope. Same blank form as POST /api/v1/forms when no conversion, report, or preview is sent: title Volunteer application unless title is set, with First name and Email. Optional template volunteer-application-form or volunteer-interest-form seeds that template's fields instead, using the on-server parser. Workers AI stays off. An unknown template is an error and does not create a form. Title is at most 200 characters. MCP, an org API key, and OAuth share a limit of 60 creates per organization per hour. A website session is not counted. Returns formId and editorUrl (/app/forms/{formId}). Does not publish the form.

template.description: Optional. volunteer-application-form or volunteer-interest-form. Seeds the draft with that template instead of First name and Email.

title.description: Optional title, at most 200 characters. Omitted uses Volunteer application, or the template title when template is set. Empty uses Volunteer application.

name: create_form

settings.description: Settings the editor would show. Null when unset.

versionId.description: Version being edited, when one exists.

title: Create a blank draft form
